scope: New MiniData compare/inclusive comparison, unbounded decimal view and bounded hex methods; MiniNumber BigInt and decimal-carrier constructors, exact min/max constants, MAXIMUM and raw decimal view. Decimal constructor cases retain coefficient/scale, plain-string conversion, 64-digit rounding, 44-place truncation, numeric range checks and immutable snapshots. Cached numeric values across byte replacement, retained immutable decimal snapshots, zero padding, values beyond monetary limits, exact negative substring errors, decimal coefficient/scale/text and wire-read values outside constructor limits. All cases have independent expected fields plus direct Java/C++ comparison. No full base/JDK API or node parity claim.
